name: Strahd, the Vampire
biography:
Phase rules: Each phase has an independent 331 hit point pool. When a phase reaches 0 hit points, replace it with another phase of your choice and end all conditions affecting Strahd. By default, the order is Mage, Soldier, Vampire. A phase reduced to 0 hit points cannot be used again until Strahd completes a long rest in his coffin. If all phases reach 0 hit points, Strahd becomes an immune-to-damage mist (except sunlight) unless he is in running water or sunlight; he must reach his coffin within 2 hours or be destroyed. In his coffin, he reverts to Vampire form, is paralyzed until he regains hit points, and regains 1 hit point after 1 hour.

Shared traits: Strahd does not require air. He cannot enter a residence without an occupant's invitation. He cannot gain the benefits of a long rest except by resting in his coffin for 8 consecutive hours between dawn and dusk. He can communicate with Barovian bats, rats, and wolves, which obey his commands. If a wooden piercing weapon is driven into his heart while he is incapacitated in his coffin, he is paralyzed until the stake is removed. While he retains the Fanes, Mountain grants permanent nondetection; Swamp lets him cast major image and move earth without components; Forest lets him cast beast sense and locate creature without components. If destroyed while retaining at least one Fane, he regains a new body in his coffin after 24 hours with all hit points and phases restored.

Source block lists passive Perception 24, although Perception +16 implies passive 26. The Foundry skill calculation displays +16; verify the passive value at the table. The campaign block lists Religion +13 for this phase, while its Intelligence and proficiency bonus calculate +12; this sheet uses +12.

items.name: Close Quarters Fighter
items.description: Strahd does not have disadvantage on his ranged attack rolls when within 5 feet of a hostile creature.

items.name: Regeneration
items.description: Strahd regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point and is not in sunlight. If he takes radiant damage, this trait does not function at the start of his next turn.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.description: Strahd can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving his hands free.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
items.description: While in sunlight, Strahd takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

items.name: Fast Grappler
items.description: Strahd does not have to spend extra movement to move a creature grappled by him if the creature is the same size or smaller.

items.name: Multiattack
items.description: Strahd makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite. He can replace one attack with charm.

items.name: Unarmed Strike
items.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. Strahd can grapple the target (escape DC 20).

items.name: Bite
items.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature grappled by Strahd, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by the necrotic damage taken, and Strahd regains hit points equal to that amount. A humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a vampire spawn under Strahd's control. If not bitten in the last 24 hours, a target can roll one Hit Die and add its Constitution modifier after a long rest to regain maximum hit points, up to its original maximum.

items.name: Charm
items.description: One humanoid within 30 feet that Strahd can see makes a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or is magically charmed for 1 minute or until Strahd loses concentration, as if concentrating on a spell. A target that cannot see Strahd automatically succeeds. While charmed, the target regards Strahd as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected; it is not controlled, but takes his requests and actions in the most favorable way and lets him bite it. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If still charmed at the end of 1 minute, the effect lasts for 24 hours, until Strahd is destroyed, or until he ends it as a bonus action.

items.name: Bats' Frenzy
items.description: Each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 15 (6d4) necrotic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of Strahd's next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and has no disadvantage.

items.name: Predator's Fury
items.description: Strahd targets up to two creatures he can see within 60 feet that are within 5 feet of each other. Each target makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (2d10 + 5) force damage and falling prone on a failure, or half damage without falling prone on a success.

items.name: Shapechange
items.description: If Strahd is not in running water or sunlight, he polymorphs into a Tiny bat, a Medium wolf, a Medium cloud of mist, or back into his true form. His statistics other than size and speed are unchanged. Worn equipment transforms; carried equipment does not. He reverts to true form if he dies. In mist form, he cannot take actions, speak, or manipulate objects; he is weightless, flies 30 feet, hovers, can enter and stop in hostile creatures' spaces, and can pass through spaces air can pass through without squeezing. He cannot pass through water, has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves, and is immune to nonmagical damage except sunlight.

items.name: Multiple Reactions
items.description: Strahd can take up to three reactions per round, but only one per turn. If an effect or condition would prevent him from taking reactions, he loses one reaction instead.

items.name: Indomitable
items.description: Trigger: A hostile creature ends its turn. Strahd repeats the saving throw against one effect or condition currently affecting him. This has no effect if the effect did not originally require a failed saving throw.

items.name: Night's Retreat
items.description: In response to taking damage, Strahd flies up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If one or more creatures have grappled him, he breaks free of the grapples.

items.name: Blood Frenzy
items.description: In response to taking damage, Strahd moves up to his speed toward the attacker and makes an unarmed strike against it.

items.name: Change Weather (Mountain Fane)
items.description: At initiative count 20 outdoors, while the Mountain Fane has not been reconsecrated, Strahd casts control weather as an action without concentration or components and can change any number of weather conditions to the spell's listed stages.

items.name: Call Lightning (Mountain Fane)
items.description: At initiative count 20 outdoors, while the Mountain Fane has not been reconsecrated, Strahd casts or uses call lightning without components or concentration. While outdoors in a storm, the spell deals maximum lightning damage.
